_README: Optional IL2CPP API module-relative RVAs, for hardened targets whose libil2cpp export NAMES are stripped/encrypted so the locator cannot resolve il2cpp_* by name. Move the block below to a top-level 'libil2cpp.so' key and fill hex RVAs obtained from a static analysis of a DECRYPTED libil2cpp dump you are authorised to produce. Vantage does NOT produce that dump and does NOT defeat any protection. Once provided, the metadata-recovery tool locates the read-only API and walks the in-memory type system. Keys must match agent/il2cpp/api_defs.js.
